summary: Phase 1.5 Quick Guide review — 7 new modals + regression + persistence + seed_ids + content_version + lint. Content wiring is 100% correct across all 11 articles: every ? button is present at the specified selector, every Card-1 heading matches spec, every guide has 5 cards ending with 'Common mistake', every ID chip renders, seen_ids[] contains all 11 IDs on fresh install, content_version='1.1.0' in Settings, lint script exits 0. Close-flow (X → confirm → Yes → hint toast) fires correctly. Persistence works: 👍 on IRR-1300 was written to app_settings.quickguide.feedback.helpful_ids and survived reload with the emerald-ring 'voted' state on card 5. HOWEVER: a CRITICAL interaction bug affects real users on 6 of 7 new integrations (and BackupRestore) — see rca_of_the_issue.

ui_bugs.issue: When QG modal is opened from within a Radix Dialog host (PantryModal, KidDashboardModal, MealPlannerModal, BarcodeScannerModal, FloatingCalendarModal, BackupRestoreModal, NoteModal — ALL 7 new Phase 1.5 wirings + Backup), Radix sets document.body.style.pointer-events='none' (inline) which cascades down through every ancestor of the QG modal. Computed pointer-events on quickguide-next, quickguide-feedback-yes/no, quickguide-more-help, and quickguide-prev is 'none'. document.elementFromPoint at the button center returns the div underneath, not the button. Real users CANNOT click Next to advance cards, cannot vote 👍/👎 on card 5, cannot access More Help. In Home context (IRR-1000, no Radix parent) pointer-events computes 'auto' and everything works — proving the regression is Radix-scoped. Ancestor trace: BUTTON pe=none → wrapper divs pe=none → quickguide-modal pe=none → app-container pe=none → BODY inline pointerEvents='none' (set by Radix Dialog). Close-X and close-confirm dialog happen to still be clickable in some cases because Radix's own AlertDialog inside CloseConfirmDialog re-injects pointer-events:auto on its portal, and the close-btn.click() fires via keyboard/aria paths. Only the ?-button (opens QG) and the X-icon (via absolute positioning + focus routing) are reliably clickable for real users — the actual guide navigation is dead.

Not a Phase 1.5 regression (this is the original pilot article) but worth harmonizing so users get a consistent last-card contract. integration_issues.issue: See ui_bugs #1 — pointer-events:none blocks all in-modal clicks. Tested with JS-dispatched clicks and everything works (state changes, persistence, IDB writes are all correct); the bug is purely at the mouse/pointer input layer.

action_items: FIX (one-line): In /app/frontend/src/quickguide/QuickGuideModal.jsx around line 88-96, add `style={{ pointerEvents: 'auto' }}` to the outer overlay div (the one with className='fixed inset-0 z-[85] ...'). This explicitly overrides the body-level inline `pointer-events: none` that Radix Dialog injects when any Dialog is open. Verified this is the root cause via computed-style ancestor trace: BODY inline_pe='none' cascades down through app-container → quickguide-modal → wrapper divs → button, making the button's computed pointer-events = 'none'. Alternative fix: render QuickGuideModal via ReactDOM.createPortal into a container that lives outside <body> children — but the simpler fix is the pointerEvents:auto style override. Please re-verify Next-click and vote-click actually advance/register in Pantry/Meal Planner/Barcode/Kid Mode/Backup/Note Editor/Calendar contexts after the fix.
(Minor) Consider updating IRR-1000.json to use card[0].heading='What Home does' and card[4].heading='Common mistake' so the pattern is uniform across all 11 articles.
critical_code_review_comments: The QuickGuideModal is not portalled — it renders in the normal React tree inside a Radix-Dialog-hosted subtree, so it inherits the Dialog's body-level pointer-events:none. A React portal to document.body's root (or an explicit pointerEvents:auto on the overlay div) would decouple it.

GuideFeedback pointer-events:none impact means the persistence hard-earned in iter_49/50 is unusable to real mouse users in 7 of 11 contexts. Backend/state code is correct — this is purely a CSS-inheritance regression exposed by putting QG inside Radix dialogs.

rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE: Radix UI Dialog primitive (@radix-ui/react-dialog) sets document.body.style.pointerEvents='none' inline whenever a Dialog is open, as part of its focus-trap/scroll-lock overlay mechanism. It then restores pointer-events:auto only on its own Dialog.Content via CSS. The QuickGuideModal is rendered as a normal React child in the same tree (not portalled outside body), so its outer div, inner card, nav-row, and all buttons INHERIT pointer-events:'none' from body. Verified with computed-style ancestor trace on Next-button in Pantry context: BUTTON→DIV→DIV→quickguide-modal→app-container→BODY(inline pe=none, computed pe=none). In Home context (no Radix Dialog open) body pe='auto' so QG works fine — the only difference between working (Home) and broken (Pantry/Meal Planner/Barcode/Kid Mode/Backup/Note Editor/Calendar) contexts is presence of a Radix Dialog above the QG. REPRODUCTION: (1) Open Pantry via [data-testid=header-pantry] (2) Click [data-testid=quickguide-btn-IRR-1300] — QG modal renders on top visually (3) Click [data-testid=quickguide-next] — nothing happens; card stays on 1-of-5. (4) elementFromPoint at button center returns the underlying pantry-empty-state div, not the button. FIX: Add `style={{ pointerEvents: 'auto' }}` to the outermost div in QuickGuideModal.jsx (line 88-96), which will override the body-inherited none for the entire QG subtree. Alternatively render QG via ReactDOM.createPortal to document.body (but body's inline pointer-events:none would still apply to portal children — the pointerEvents:auto style override is the correct fix). MITIGATION IN TESTS: use JS-dispatched .click() until fix ships.
